## Server

### Fixed
- Server backups now leave out linked folders, linked files and hard-linked files, so a backup only holds files from the server's own save folder. If the save folder itself sits behind a link, the server refuses to back it up.
Running this server code yourself is not supported (see the README), but if you do, update to 0.1.100.

Players need nothing installed: in Solarpunk's main menu choose Join session, type the server's 5-letter code and press Done.

---
Hosting: [SurvivalServers.com](https://www.survivalservers.com/services/game_servers/solarpunk/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=release&utm_campaign=sundialserver) runs Sundial for you.
